## Summary
What does this pull request change, and why?

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New analysis or feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Demo (`docs/`)

## Checklist
- [ ] Changes are in `v2/` or shared folders; `v1/` is unchanged (it mirrors the `v1.0` tag)
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated with their generator, not edited by hand (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Every new or changed number is read from a results file
- [ ] No dataset files or large binaries added
- [ ] `pytest -q tests` passes
- [ ] `node tests/test_logic.js` passes
- [ ] `cd v2 && python scripts/check_samples.py` passes (if the model, presets or demo changed)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`python scripts/build_documentation.py` from `v2/`) if behaviour or results changed
